sections.Profile:
"Around the World" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1959. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features a travel theme, as suggested by its title.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Travel, Wood Rail, Space
